newsitem.title: INDIA: India SCICI 1st half net profit falls.
newsitem.headline: India SCICI 1st half net profit falls.

text.p: India's financial and leasing services firm, SCICI said on Saturday its net profit fell 8.1 percent to 666 million rupees for the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) against 725 million in the year-ago period.
The company said capital gains realisations dropped to 0.27 million rupees in the first half compared to 156 million in the year ago.
SCICI said depressed market conditions led to the sharp decline in capital gains in the current year.
Loan approvals fell to 13.57 billion rupees in 1996/97 against 35.11 billion while disbursements rose 9.3 percent to 11.04 billion from 10.10 billion in the previous year.
